status: specified before examination of any new test predictions
training_data: only LoCoMo first six dialogue IDs, first four sessions for this iteration; no labels or scored examples from LongMemEval
development: LoCoMo fixed validation dialogues, first six sessions; full development histories available for method selection

primary.benchmark: LoCoMo, full fixed MemSkill test split
primary.metric: Native per-question token F1, all 314 non-adversarial questions; 86 category-5 without ordinary reference answers outside primary endpoint. Show micro, per-type and each dialogue.

external.benchmark: LongMemEval-S, full fixed MemSkill test split
external.metric: Compute native token F1 for all 101 answerable histories; include 4 abstentions as a separate evaluation. Report per-type and macro, paired bootstrap by history. Do not pool with LoCoMo or call token F1 the official LLM-judge accuracy.

coverage: Process every session in chronological order; do not filter by gold evidence, correctness, or support for the method.
comparison: All arms share the frozen actor, nine skills, data, encoder, memory and 8B inference budget. Fit only the two compared gate corrections on training rollouts. Include always-grounded validation control.
gain_criterion: On full LoCoMo: >=0.02 absolute mean F1 vs terminal-only and native, positive on each held-out dialogue. For a generalization claim require positive transfer with a paired CI, not only LoCoMo. Report all deltas and uncertainty.
policy: Record on identical states the probability of selecting the grounding option under both policies, actual chosen tuples, output token and memory cost. Test only after development recipe is frozen.
